title: Authorize the Token Transfer
description: A reward contract moves a fee from the player to the treasury through the Stellar asset contract. The call compiles and the token contract exists, yet every invocation panics with an authorization error.
hint: A cross-contract client call does not authorize anyone by itself. The calling contract must call `require_auth` on the address whose balance is debited, and it must do so before the transfer. Authorizing the token contract or the treasury cannot satisfy the player's authorization entry.
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: Player authorization requested
testCases.description: The address whose funds move must authorize the invocation.
